Architecture

Leader: Dennis Gabriel · 2 members · 0 projects

The Core Architecture Team is responsible for leading solution design activities related to UPM+, including conducting comprehensive impact assessments across upstream and downstream systems. The team ensures that proposed changes are technically sound, aligned with business requirements, and assessed for potential impacts on system integrations, data flows, existing functionalities, and dependent applications. The team also collaborates with relevant stakeholders to identify dependencies, address technical risks, and ensure solutions are scalable, maintainable, and aligned with the overall system architecture.
